select distinct pp.PORTFOLIO_ID id,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME text from PTL_PORTFOLIO pp INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ pmo ON pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pmo.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ppa ON pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = ppa.PORTFOLIO_ID AND ppa.USER_ID = #{userId} where pmo.MANAGE_OBJ_TYPE=#{manageObjType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND pmo.MANAGE_OBJ_ID in (select FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE = #{profitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select ASSET_CLASSIFY as assetClassify, round(INVEST_MAX*100,2) as investMax, round(INVEST_MIN*100,2) as investMin from PTL_GOAL where FINPROD_ID = #{pFinprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select distinct A.CCY, B.REP_RISK_LEVEL, C.PROFIT_FLAG, (select round(E.YIELD*100,2) from FIN_CASH_INFO D, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E where D.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND D.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_TYPE_1= #{cashType1Cost,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2Trustee,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID AND E.IS_INITIAL = #{yes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) as TRUSTEESHIPRATE, (select round(E.YIELD*100,2) from FIN_CASH_INFO D, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E where D.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.BRANCH= #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND D.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1Cost,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2Sales,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID AND E.IS_INITIAL = #{yes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) as SALESFEERATE, (select round(E.YIELD*100,2) from FIN_CASH_INFO D, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E where D.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.BRANCH = #{branch,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND D.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1Rate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2Rate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.CASH_ID = E.CASH_ID AND E.IS_INITIAL = #{yes,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) as EXPECTEDYIELD from FIN_PRODUCT A, REP_PROD_DECLARE B, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C where A.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.REP_FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND C.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
